remarks: Welcome to your dream home, a beautiful ranch nestled on a tranquil street in West Norwalk. 30 Forbell Drive is a beautifully maintained three-bedroom residence, showcasing meticulous care and attention to detail.  As you step outside, you'll be captivated by the stunning yard, a testament to the previous owner's talent in the garden. This incredible outdoor space is a completely private oasis (and fully fenced!), bursting with vibrant flowers and lush greenery. Enjoy the luxury of an enclosed hot tub and a heated above-ground pool, providing the ideal setting for relaxation and summer fun with family and friends. Inside, the generously sized kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas, creating an inviting atmosphere for gatherings and entertaining. The additional family room features sliding doors that lead to the back patio, flooding the space with natural light and offering easy access to your outdoor paradise. The spacious primary bedroom boasts its own private bathroom, ensuring a peaceful retreat at the end of the day. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed full bathroom. With its incredible outdoor space, bright and airy interiors, and fantastic location, 30 Forbell Drive is a must-see! Enjoy one-level living on one of West Norwalk's prettiest streets. Don't miss this opportunity to make this special property yours.  *inclusions and exclusions are attached to the listing This is an estate, there are no disclosures.
